job.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Contract
job.description:
We are seeking a senior-level Talent Acquisition Partner to join a growing organization on a contract basis. This role will serve as a strategic recruiting partner focused exclusively on field leadership and operational management positions.

The TA Partner will manage approximately 8–10 complex leadership searches, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from intake through offer acceptance. This is an ideal opportunity for a seasoned recruiter who is comfortable working independently, partnering directly with senior operational leaders, and developing creative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.

This is a hybrid role (3 days in-office, 2 days WFH). The selected candidate should be prepared to spend approximately the first week onsite for training, business immersion, and stakeholder introductions.

Location: Brea, CA
Employment Type: Contract – Approximately 6 Months
Compensation: $65–$75/hour DOE

CORE DUTIES

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for approximately 8–10 field leadership and operational searches.
  • Partner directly with senior leaders and hiring managers to understand business needs, define candidate profiles, and establish effective recruiting strategies.
  • Recruit primarily for General Manager, Operations Manager, Sales Manager, Plumbing Manager, Electrical Manager, and other field leadership positions.
  • Develop and execute proactive sourcing and headhunting strategies to identify passive leadership talent.
  • Conduct thorough candidate assessment and provide clear recommendations to hiring leaders.
  • Build and maintain strong pipelines for difficult-to-fill leadership positions.
  • Provide hiring managers with meaningful market intelligence, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive activity, and recurring candidate feedback.
  • Diagnose challenges within searches and independently recommend adjustments to sourcing strategy, candidate profile, compensation, or other search parameters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with senior stakeholders throughout the recruiting process.
  • Manage candidates through the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and closing.
  • Represent the organization professionally and build a strong candidate experience throughout the process.
  • Utilize recruiting data, market research, and sourcing insights to continuously improve search outcomes.


    WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 7+ years of progressive recruiting / talent acquisition experience, with significant experience supporting management and leadership-level searches.
  • Proven success recruiting passive candidates through direct sourcing and headhunting.
  • Experience managing multiple complex searches simultaneously.
  • Strong executive presence and confidence partnering with senior operational leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence hiring managers and provide thoughtful recruiting recommendations.
  • Strong candidate assessment skills, with the ability to clearly articulate candidate strengths, concerns, and overall fit.
  • Highly consultative and solutions-oriented approach to recruiting.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand how talent needs connect to operational goals.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and operate with a high degree of ownership.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


    PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

    Experience recruiting within one or more of the following environments is highly desirable:

  • HVAC
  • Plumbing
  • Electrical
  • Skilled trades
  • Home services
  • Field operations
  • Multi-location organizations
  • Private equity-backed organizations

    Experience with Greenhouse or other modern ATS platforms is a plus.

    THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

    We are looking for someone who operates as a true Talent Acquisition Partner—not simply a recruiter executing requisitions.

    The right person will be comfortable telling a hiring leader what the market is saying, why a search may not be producing results, and what should change to improve the outcome.

    You should be someone who naturally asks:

    Who are we targeting? → What are candidates telling us? → Where is the search breaking down? → What does the market tell us? → What should we change?

    If you enjoy difficult searches, passive talent acquisition, senior stakeholder partnership, and having real ownership over the recruiting strategy, this could be an excellent fit.

job.title: TA Specialist - Temporary (6 months)
job.description:
About TalentCount

TalentCount is partnering with a rapidly growing organization in the home services industry to identify an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to join their recruiting team. This is an exciting opportunity for a high-energy, highly organized recruiter who can step into a fast-paced environment and immediately contribute to a significant recruiting workload.

The organization is currently managing 180+ open positions and is looking for additional recruiting support to help accelerate hiring across multiple locations, business units, and brands.

The ideal candidate is both a high-volume recruiter and a true Talent Acquisition partner - someone who can move quickly, proactively source candidates, build strong relationships with hiring managers, and use recruiting data and market insights to improve hiring strategies.

Position Overview

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will manage the full life cycle recruiting process for positions within a designated division or region. This includes sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate assessment, ATS management, background and substance screening, offer preparation, and onboarding coordination.

This person will work closely with hiring managers to understand workforce needs and develop effective recruiting strategies. The successful candidate will not simply take a requisition and begin searching; they will learn the business, understand the market, identify recruiting challenges, and proactively recommend solutions.

The typical workload is approximately 15–20 open requisitions, with the potential to increase to 25–40+ requisitions during periods of high demand. Certain high-volume divisions may carry approximately 50 open positions.

Core Duties

  • Manage the full life cycle recruiting process for a high volume of positions across designated locations and business units
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand workforce needs and hiring priorities
  • Partner with hiring managers to develop recruiting strategies and ensure positions are effectively positioned in the market
  • Manage approximately 15–20 requisitions under normal conditions, with the ability to effectively prioritize 25–40+ requisitions during peak periods
  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, ATS databases, networking, employee referrals, direct sourcing, trade schools, military resources, and other creative recruiting channels
  • Conduct candidate outreach, pre-screening, interviewing, assessments, and selection activities
  • Coordinate background checks, substance screening, offer letters, onboarding, and other pre-employment activities
  • Maintain accurate candidate activity, dispositions, interview information, offers, and onboarding status within the ATS
  • Use ATS and recruiting data to prepare reports, identify trends, and provide recommendations to hiring managers and TA leadership
  • Leverage market intelligence, competitor information, compensation data, and industry trends to help shape recruiting strategies
  • Identify when a recruiting strategy or search is not producing results and proactively recommend adjustments
  • Develop a strong understanding of the business, positions, locations, and workforce needs to effectively advise hiring managers
  • Build and maintain relationships with trade schools, military bases, community organizations, and other talent pipelines
  • Coordinate and participate in recruiting events and hiring initiatives
  • Track recruiting event and candidate activity to evaluate effectiveness and inform future strategies
  • Provide guidance to hiring managers regarding compliant interviewing and selection practices
  • Ensure recruiting and onboarding activities are conducted in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations
  • Collaborate with internal HR and TA teams to continuously improve recruiting processes and candidate experience
  • Perform additional projects and duties as assigned

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or related HR experience
  • Demonstrated experience managing high-volume recruiting and multiple requisitions simultaneously
  • Strong hiring-manager and stakeholder partnership skills
  • Proven ability to independently source and identify qualified candidates
  • Experience managing the full recruiting life cycle from sourcing through onboarding
  • 2+ years of experience working with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
  • Greenhouse experience strongly preferred
  • Strong Indeed and LinkedIn recruiting/sourcing experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to prioritize competing requisitions and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal direction
  • Comfortable using data and market information to influence recruiting conversations and hiring decisions
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Working knowledge of HR operations, hiring practices, employment compliance, and applicable labor laws
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% within the designated region

Preferred Qualifications

  • Skilled trades recruiting experience
  • Electrical recruiting experience — highly preferred
  • Plumbing or HVAC recruiting experience
  • Residential or commercial home services recruiting
  • Construction or field operations recruiting
  • High-volume hourly or blue-collar recruiting
  • Multi-unit recruiting experience
  • Multi-brand recruiting experience
  • Multi-state recruiting experience
  • Experience recruiting across multiple locations and business units
  • Experience with trade schools, military recruiting, or other non-traditional talent pipelines
  • Experience with market mapping, compensation research, and recruiting analytics
  • Experience supporting a rapidly growing organization

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a recruiter who can move fast without becoming transactional.

They should be comfortable managing a substantial requisition load while still taking the time to understand what each hiring manager and business unit actually needs. They know how to ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions appropriately, research unfamiliar positions, and use data or market information to help solve recruiting challenges.

We are especially interested in candidates who have recruited for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, skilled trades, field operations, or other high-volume hourly populations. Experience across multiple units, brands, locations, or states is a major plus.

However, direct industry experience is not required. Strong recruiting fundamentals, sourcing ability, organization, urgency, business curiosity, and genuine hiring-manager partnership are the most important factors.

Why This Opportunity

  • Immediate opportunity to make an impact within a rapidly growing organization
  • 180+ active openings creating significant recruiting exposure and variety
  • Opportunity to work across multiple locations, divisions, and brands
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days onsite and 2 days remote
  • Potential opportunity to convert to a permanent position
  • High visibility and direct partnership with hiring managers
  • Opportunity to influence recruiting strategy using market data and talent insights
  • Fast-paced environment ideal for a recruiter who enjoys ownership, urgency, and getting results

job.title: Payroll & Benefits Specialist
job.description:
At TalentCount, we connect exceptional payroll, accounting, and people operations professionals with organizations where accuracy, compliance, and employee experience are critical to success. We are currently supporting a confidential search for a Payroll & Benefits Specialist to join a well-established educational institution serving approximately 500 employees.

This is a highly hands-on, individual contributor role responsible for owning the day-to-day administration of payroll and benefits operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Human Resources, the Payroll & Benefits Specialist will serve as the organization's primary payroll subject matter expert, ensuring accurate payroll processing, benefits administration, compliance, reconciliations, and reporting.

This is not an HR Generalist position. The ideal candidate is a payroll professional with strong accounting acumen, advanced Excel capabilities, and a proven ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve payroll discrepancies. The successful hire will be joining a stable organization where the current incumbent is retiring after 27 years in the role.

What You'll Do

Payroll Administration (Primary Focus)

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for approximately 500 employees.
  • Process bi-weekly and monthly payroll while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Audit payroll data, investigate discrepancies, and resolve payroll-related issues.
  • Perform payroll reconciliations, tax reporting, deductions administration, and year-end processing.
  • Partner closely with Finance to ensure accurate payroll accounting and general ledger reporting.
  • Prepare payroll-related reports and provide data analysis to leadership.

Benefits Administration

  • Administer employee benefits programs including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement, and voluntary benefits.
  • Manage employee enrollments, life event changes, open enrollment, and vendor relationships.
  • Reconcile carrier invoices and benefit deductions against payroll records.
  • Administer leave programs including FMLA, ADA accommodations, COBRA, and related compliance activities.

Systems, Compliance & Reporting

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Paycor and related payroll systems.
  • Develop reports, tools, and processes to improve payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Support audits, regulatory filings, workers' compensation administration, and compliance reporting.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and payroll documentation.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on payroll administration experience.
  • Experience owning payroll processing for 200+ employees; experience supporting 500+ employees strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of payroll reconciliations, payroll taxes, garnishments, deductions, and compliance requirements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including:
    • VLOOKUPs
    • Pivot Tables
    • Complex formulas
    • Workbook creation and reporting tools
  • Experience working with accounting teams and understanding:
    • Journal entries
    • General ledger impacts
    • Payroll accounting
    • Financial reconciliations
  • Experience with Paycor, UKG, Paycom, Paylocity, Workday Payroll, or similar payroll platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within education, nonprofit, or mission-driven organizations.
  • CPP or FPC certification.
  • Benefits administration experience.
  • Retirement plan administration experience.
  • Bilingual Spanish and/or French language skills.
  • Demonstrated career stability and long-term tenure with previous employers.

Compensation

  • $85,000 - $95,000 annually
  • Non-Exempt (Overtime Eligible)
  • Comprehensive benefits package

Work Environment

  • Onsite in Houston, TX
  • Collaborative three-person HR team
  • Stable, mission-driven organization with long-tenured leadership and employees

job.title: Payroll Supervisor
job.description:
At TalentCount, we believe Human Resources is the engine that drives business success, and a strong workplace culture creates the foundation for long-term growth. We take pride in partnering with organizations that value collaboration, accountability, and employee development.

Are you a payroll professional who enjoys balancing leadership responsibilities with hands-on payroll processing? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where accuracy, compliance, and problem-solving are critical? If so, our client would love to connect with you!

Our client is seeking a Payroll Supervisor to oversee payroll operations while actively participating in day-to-day payroll processing. This individual will play a key role in ensuring accurate and timely payroll administration across multiple states and pay structures while supporting and mentoring a growing payroll team.

Core Duties:

  • Manage full-cycle payroll processing in a multi-state and multi-entity environment using ADP Workforce Now.
  • Review and process a variety of pay structures, including commissions, bonuses, and piece-rate compensation.
  • Audit payroll data such as earnings, deductions, timecards, and adjustments to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Handle off-cycle payroll requests, including manual checks, final pay processing, and payroll corrections.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to payroll staff while remaining actively involved in payroll operations.
  • Support quarter-end and year-end payroll activities, reconciliations, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor payroll compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations.
  • Investigate payroll discrepancies and perform variance analysis between pay periods.
  • Partner cross-functionally with HR, Finance, and IT teams to improve payroll workflows and resolve system-related issues.
  • Generate payroll-related reports, analytics, and supporting documentation for leadership and audits.
  • Conduct training sessions for field employees and operational teams regarding payroll procedures and wage compliance updates.
  • Assist with payroll-related audit requests, including workers’ compensation, benefits, and financial audits.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years of progressive payroll experience, including commission and piece-rate payroll processing.
  • Prior experience in a lead or supervisory payroll capacity.
  • Strong understanding of multi-state payroll regulations, garnishments, and wage compliance requirements.
  • Experience processing payroll independently with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with payroll systems; ADP Workforce Now experience is highly preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, and payroll data analysis.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • CPP certification or related payroll certification is considered an asset.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred.

Why Join?

  • Competitive compensation with benefits.
  • Opportunities for long-term career growth and advancement.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) matching.
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented work environment with supportive leadership.

 

Compensation: $110,000-$125,000/yr
